sources.games: 562 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 51.4%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py muerta.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Muerta players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 29% of 34 games against them (6% otherwise), won 60% against 38%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Muerta players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 61% of 61 games against them (37% otherwise), won 70% against 38%. Silver Edge is in her build (~30 min).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 76% (-2), falcon_blade 80% (5), power_treads 99% (8), maelstrom 96% (14), mask_of_madness 37% (14), dragon_lance 92% (20), mjollnir 86% (22), invis_sword 53% (25), force_staff 69% (26), hurricane_pike 68% (26), black_king_bar 66% (27), silver_edge 50% (28), lesser_crit 51% (32), greater_crit 40% (35), satanic 28% (38), swift_blink 22% (44).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 25:00 17000 (42 games, 85.7%), 30:00 20000 (107 games, 86.9%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 562 games: maxed muerta_dead_shot > muerta_gunslinger > muerta_the_calling 402 (win 56.2%), muerta_dead_shot > muerta_gunslinger 69 (win 24.6%), muerta_gunslinger > muerta_dead_shot > muerta_the_calling 67 (win 55.2%); talents 10: +20 Attack Speed 491/561 (51.1%), Dead Shot Cast Range 70/561 (54.3%); 15: +15 Intelligence 507/536 (53.1%), Max HP Regen while inside The Calling 29/536 (55.2%); 20: special_bonus_unique_muerta_pierce_the_veil_duration 411/417 (60.6%), The Calling summons additional revenants 6/417 (66.7%); 25: special_bonus_unique_muerta_gunslinger_double_shot_chance 137/147 (70.1%), special_bonus_unique_muerta_dead_shot_charges 10/147 (60.0%).
